L0_code_verified.evidence: A1-A7 (element benchmarks, rigid body, equilibrium, symmetry, independent assembly, linearity)

L1_solution_verified.evidence: B (energy-minimisation cross-check), C1-C5 (reliability quadrature/MC convergence), D1-D3 (optimiser vs brute force), E (periodic cell energy/stress consistency), F4/F5 (mass basis audited), H (counts/determinism), J/K (model-form bands and v0.3/v0.4 features: K4 process gate, K5 brittle marginal, K6 union polish, K7 assumption bounds, K8 report disclosures)

L2_literature_calibrated_uq.evidence: rPETG preset moments/correlation verified internally (G); literature provenance not independently re-derived here

L3_literature_reproduced.evidence: coupon/bracket blind predictions (stiffness, first-yield, strain, brittle marginal), protocol and acceptance criteria frozen and hashed (L1); no measurements have been made

model_form_limitations.no_experiments: No physical specimens were tested; nothing here is experimental validation.
model_form_limitations.frame_vs_part: The 2-D plane-frame idealisation omits 3-D load paths, out-of-plane bending/buckling and plate action.
model_form_limitations.joints: Printed node/joint compliance and local stress concentrations are not modelled; rigid joints assumed.
model_form_limitations.anisotropy: Layer-adhesion/road-direction anisotropy is not modelled (measured printed in-plane strength used).
model_form_limitations.plasticity: Linear elasticity only; no yield plateau, strain localisation, or failure criterion beyond first yield.
model_form_limitations.time_dependence: Creep, fatigue, UV and thermal ageing are not modelled.
model_form_limitations.spatial_scatter: Material scatter is batch-uniform, not spatial; print-defect statistics absent.
model_form_limitations.buckling_model: Euler buckling with pinned-pinned effective length; no combined axial-bending interaction.
model_form_limitations.material_provenance: Feedstock distributions are literature-derived priors, not the user's measured lots.
model_form_limitations.mass_overcount: Analytic mass is a conservative upper bound (F4): it double-counts strut overlap. Corrected over-count of the printed union: +5.6% at w=1 mm, +12.2% at w=2 mm, +27.9% at w=4 mm; shipped robust design +9.5% (analytic 50.81 g vs printed union 46.39 g). The engine reports the Halton-QMC printed union as headline mass (F5, accurate to <0.3%); always label analytic mass as 'upper bound'.
model_form_limitations.optimiser_scope: D validates a reduced 2-parameter family and checks the shipped 8-parameter result; it does not prove global optimality of the 8-parameter problem.
model_form_limitations.cell_size_model_form: Predictions depend strongly on the cell count: generalised 4x2-14x6 lattices on the same envelope change u_tip by ~58% and strength demand by ~98% at matched mass (J1). The 7x3 layout is the product contract; do not transfer absolute numbers to other cell counts.
model_form_limitations.joint_model_form: Rigid-frame idealisation vs pin-jointed truss: tip stiffness differs by only 0.4%, but frame demands are 14% (strength) and 9% (stiffness) higher (J2); real printed joints lie between these bounds.
model_form_limitations.sustained_load: Sustained-load/creep advisory bound fails the static allowable: bound P_f ~1.0 and bound deflection ~4.0 mm > 2.5 mm limit (K1). The static design is NOT qualified for sustained load.
model_form_limitations.coupon_not_tested: The coupon/bracket plan is pre-registered only (L1); no physical measurements exist. Claim level remains L0-L1, L2 partial, L3 pre-registered.
model_form_limitations.brittle_screen_marginal: The brittle-lot screen is a one-property lognormal marginal (pf_brittle) reported as an add-on estimate (not a formal bound); the joint three-property probability is NOT claimed because the E-elongation correlation (-0.25) is assumed. It uses an elongation-specific lot/within split (rPETG 50% between lots vs 85% for E/sy) and a fixed 1% brittle_ok threshold that is not the design target (K5).
model_form_limitations.assumption_bounds_not_validation: The reported P_f range over corr 0.30/0.70 and lot split 75/95% is sensitivity to unmeasured assumptions, not validation; the split is the dominant exposure (~6x P_f swing on the shipped design, K7).
model_form_limitations.process_gate_scope: Only FDM/FFF material data may enter the printed-bracket model; moulded/injection presets are contrast-only and design is blocked (K4). This is a claim gate, not a mechanical validation of printed-part properties.
model_form_limitations.printed_union_discretisation: The deterministic 60k-point Halton printed-union estimate deviates from an independent 10M-sample Monte Carlo by <=0.1% at the shipped designs but by 0.35% at w=1 mm (W_MIN) — beyond the documented 0.3% claim (F5 WARN). Analytic mass is a deliberate upper bound (F4 WARN).

checks.claim: Generalised X-braced lattices 4x2/7x3/10x4/14x6 mm on the same envelope: cell-size choice, not only numerical refinement, changes predictions

checks.title: Joint-stiffness / topology model-form: rigid frame vs pin-jointed truss

checks.method: 2-DOF/node pin-jointed truss solver vs the rigid-joint frame; tip stiffness, sigma_req and E_req ratios

checks.title: Model-form limitations are enumerated and quantified where possible
checks.claim: The report states what the checks do NOT validate, including the mass over-count quantified in F4
checks.method: Limitations register compiled from PRODUCT_SPEC §7, REPORT §6 and checks A-H

evidence.no_experiments: No physical specimens were tested; nothing here is experimental validation.
evidence.frame_vs_part: The 2-D plane-frame idealisation omits 3-D load paths, out-of-plane bending/buckling and plate action.
evidence.joints: Printed node/joint compliance and local stress concentrations are not modelled; rigid joints assumed.
evidence.anisotropy: Layer-adhesion/road-direction anisotropy is not modelled (measured printed in-plane strength used).
evidence.plasticity: Linear elasticity only; no yield plateau, strain localisation, or failure criterion beyond first yield.
evidence.time_dependence: Creep, fatigue, UV and thermal ageing are not modelled.
evidence.spatial_scatter: Material scatter is batch-uniform, not spatial; print-defect statistics absent.
evidence.buckling_model: Euler buckling with pinned-pinned effective length; no combined axial-bending interaction.
evidence.material_provenance: Feedstock distributions are literature-derived priors, not the user's measured lots.
evidence.mass_overcount: Analytic mass is a conservative upper bound (F4): it double-counts strut overlap. Corrected over-count of the printed union: +5.6% at w=1 mm, +12.2% at w=2 mm, +27.9% at w=4 mm; shipped robust design +9.5% (analytic 50.81 g vs printed union 46.39 g). The engine reports the Halton-QMC printed union as headline mass (F5, accurate to <0.3%); always label analytic mass as 'upper bound'.
evidence.optimiser_scope: D validates a reduced 2-parameter family and checks the shipped 8-parameter result; it does not prove global optimality of the 8-parameter problem.
evidence.cell_size_model_form: Predictions depend strongly on the cell count: generalised 4x2-14x6 lattices on the same envelope change u_tip by ~58% and strength demand by ~98% at matched mass (J1). The 7x3 layout is the product contract; do not transfer absolute numbers to other cell counts.
evidence.joint_model_form: Rigid-frame idealisation vs pin-jointed truss: tip stiffness differs by only 0.4%, but frame demands are 14% (strength) and 9% (stiffness) higher (J2); real printed joints lie between these bounds.
evidence.sustained_load: Sustained-load/creep advisory bound fails the static allowable: bound P_f ~1.0 and bound deflection ~4.0 mm > 2.5 mm limit (K1). The static design is NOT qualified for sustained load.
evidence.coupon_not_tested: The coupon/bracket plan is pre-registered only (L1); no physical measurements exist. Claim level remains L0-L1, L2 partial, L3 pre-registered.
evidence.brittle_screen_marginal: The brittle-lot screen is a one-property lognormal marginal (pf_brittle) reported as an add-on estimate (not a formal bound); the joint three-property probability is NOT claimed because the E-elongation correlation (-0.25) is assumed. It uses an elongation-specific lot/within split (rPETG 50% between lots vs 85% for E/sy) and a fixed 1% brittle_ok threshold that is not the design target (K5).
evidence.assumption_bounds_not_validation: The reported P_f range over corr 0.30/0.70 and lot split 75/95% is sensitivity to unmeasured assumptions, not validation; the split is the dominant exposure (~6x P_f swing on the shipped design, K7).
evidence.process_gate_scope: Only FDM/FFF material data may enter the printed-bracket model; moulded/injection presets are contrast-only and design is blocked (K4). This is a claim gate, not a mechanical validation of printed-part properties.
evidence.printed_union_discretisation: The deterministic 60k-point Halton printed-union estimate deviates from an independent 10M-sample Monte Carlo by <=0.1% at the shipped designs but by 0.35% at w=1 mm (W_MIN) — beyond the documented 0.3% claim (F5 WARN). Analytic mass is a deliberate upper bound (F4 WARN).
